name: Student Residence Visa

qualifying_event.description: For foreign nationals enrolled full-time at an accredited Ecuadorian educational institution (any level, including language schools).
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Enrollment or admission certificate from an accredited Ecuadorian institution; proof of lawful means of subsistence.

requirements.blocker_text: Enrollment or admission certificate from an accredited Ecuadorian educational institution, confirming full-time student status.
Must demonstrate lawful means of subsistence per Ministerial Agreement No. 70 (28 June 2024); the tier-1 source does not state an exact dollar figure for the student category.

evidence_required.document: Proof of lawful means of subsistence

outcome.duration_length: matches the duration of the academic programme/internship, capped at 2 years

sources.title: gob.ec (MREMH official portal) -- Student residence visa: enrollment/admission requirement, lawful-means-of-subsistence requirement, duration capped at 2 years matching the study programme

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ecuador). work_rights modeled 'none' as a conservative default -- the tier-1 source did not explicitly address work authorization for student-visa holders either way, so no work right is asserted. switchable_to includes ec_permanent_residence.json since accumulated time on a valid temporary residence visa (student included) counts toward the 21-month permanent-residence conversion route.
